summary_ja: 信用リスク削減手法を適用するには、開示告示（平成二十二年金融庁告示第百三十二号）第三条に定める事項をあらかじめ開示することを求める。
summary_en: Using credit risk mitigation requires prior disclosure of the matters in Article 3 of the FSA disclosure notice (FSA Notice No. 132 of 2010).
paragraphs: In order to apply credit risk mitigation techniques, an Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the standardized approach shall disclose in advance the matters set out in Article 3 of the Notice Specifying the Matters to Be Stated in the Document in Which an Ultimate Designated Parent Company States the Status of the Soundness of Its Management, in Cases Specified by the Commissioner of the Financial Services Agency (FSA Notice No. 132 of December 2010).
